mechanism: Olanzapine may impair vitamin B12 absorption through effects on gastrointestinal motility and gastric acid secretion, and both agents can independently affect neurological function, creating potential for cumulative neuropsychiatric effects.
action: Monitor B12 levels periodically in patients on chronic olanzapine therapy; consider B12 supplementation if deficiency develops, as deficiency can worsen psychiatric symptoms and cause neuropathy.
